ideas.idea: Delete/allow the OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot blocks, block GPTBot instead for training opt-out
ideas.why: This is the known robots.txt problem, but the added GPTBot suggestion is not a separate harmful claim; it is still part of the known item.

ideas.idea: Replace Article JSON-LD with Product/Offer data for the £40/night price and add author/datePublished/dateModified/image
ideas.why: Adding Article fields is standard advice, and Product/Offer for a mooring with a single 'from' price is a stretch with little effect.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to each sitemap URL
ideas.why: Accurate but minor, and applies to nearly any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Render the FAQ Q&As from faq.json as visible HTML on the home page
ideas.why: index.astro injects FAQPage JSON-LD but the body has no visible FAQ, so markup doesn't match visible content.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Marina structured data in Base.astro using the phone number from contact.astro
ideas.why: No Organization/LocalBusiness data exists and the phone number and place are in the files, though putting it in Base would apply it to every page.

ideas.idea: Add astro.config.mjs with site and preact() integration, and consider @astrojs/sitemap
ideas.why: No config file exists, so Preact isn't registered for Newsletter.jsx and site is unset for canonicals.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset, viewport, Open Graph and Twitter tags in Base.astro
ideas.why: Accurate since these are missing, but it's standard head boilerplate that applies to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Fix title/description quality: Harbor vs harbour spelling, add place name/brand, lengthen descriptions to 120-155 characters
ideas.why: The spelling inconsistency is real in index.astro versus the body text, and the short descriptions lack place and detail, though the character-count target is folklore.

ideas.idea: Expand thin content with sizes, seasonal rates, booking steps, water taxi times and keep one page per topic
ideas.why: moorings.astro has a single price line and index.astro is two lines, so concrete quotable facts are missing.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in <main> and add header landmarks in Base.astro
ideas.why: Accurate since there's no <main>, but it's a general accessibility practice with little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Add name to the newsletter input and type to the button
ideas.why: Accurate but minor form hygiene that applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Switch Newsletter from client:load to client:visible
ideas.why: Newsletter's client:load is a stated deliberate choice, so recommending a change reverses it.
The report itself says the benefit is unproven, and llms.txt as a way to be found is folklore and a deliberate non-issue.

ideas.idea: Remove noindex or drop /contact from sitemap, and add lastmod (the decision part)
ideas.why: The mismatch is a known problem, so this is the same item and not a separate recommendation.
